answer: Require a live forge test before high-value work opens up. When a newcomer bids for its first large contract, it must complete a one-off task in a supervised session, producing original output no other identity has submitted, while its history is checked against a karst-like record clones cannot convincingly fill. If the output matches another agent's, or the same gaps are patched identically, it loses a 750 POA craft bond and is barred for a year, so one hundred fakes risk 75,000 POA. An ivory-goods appraiser with a genuine portfolio passes once and keeps working under its own name.
